scope: aggregate local model evaluation receipt; no swimmer-level records
model: turnmark-empirical-2026: equivalence map, linear in log time per event, category and course onto one SCY-anchored latent scale, held at the edge ratio beyond the training support

validation_curvature.rule: The fixed linear map, fitted on Train, scored on Validation: MAE and the decile biases by the less-coupled independent-swim diagnostic and by the coupled pair-mean one. This is where any remaining curvature is examined and whether a nonlinear stage deserves a known-truth experiment is decided; Test is not used for it, and nothing here changes the shipped map.

interval_disclosure: Bootstrap intervals resample swimmers (primary) or one meet per pair (sensitivity) with the fitted models held fixed. They do not cover model-selection uncertainty: the shrinkage priors and the noise ratios were estimated once, and the 30-day window and the outlier screen were chosen once; none is re-estimated or re-chosen inside each replicate. They also do not remove residual dependence: a pair joins two meets but is clustered on one, swimmers share clubs, coaches and taper cycles, and same-day conditions (pool, timing system, altitude) correlate errors across swimmers in ways neither clustering captures.

ability_bias_by_pair_mean_decile.description: Mean signed % error, 100 * ln(converted / actual), by decile of the pair's mean log time within its course pair, event and category (D1 fastest). Forward = SCY->LCM, SCY->SCM, SCM->LCM. The bin variable shares the pair's measurement errors, so with unequal course noise even the true equivalence map shows a trend here: a coupled diagnostic, not a test of ability bias.

ability_bias_by_independent_swim_decile.description: Mean signed % error by decile of a separate swim's log time: an ability measure that shares no swim with the pair: the swimmer's swim of the same event in the pair's canonical source course (SCY for SCY-LCM and SCY-SCM, SCM for SCM-LCM) at a meet other than either pair meet, at most max_days from the pair's swim in that course and at least min_days from both pair swims, the nearest such swim to the pair's swim in that course (ties: the earlier date, then the lower meet ID). Deciles are within (course pair, event, category) among rows that have one; both directions of a pair share it. This removes the shared measurement error that couples a pair-mean bin to the pair's residual, and the minimum gap reduces shared form and taper with either swim. It does not remove all coupling: form persists beyond a month, progression between the swims and which swimmers race often can still correlate the independent swim with the pair. Rows without an independent swim, and cells with fewer than min_pairs rows that have one, get None.
